subject: How to use stat_vline with qplot?

messages.author: c21e804e07c5e732
messages.subject: How to use stat_vline with qplot?
parts:
Hi,

I don't find a working example on how to use stat_vline with qplot.
Could anybody show me how to use stat_vline with qplot? Thank you!

http://had.co.nz/ggplot2/stat_vline.html

qplot(1:10, 1:10)+stat_vline(5)
Error in do.call("layer", list(mapping = mapping, data = data, geom = geom, :
argument "intercept" is missing, with no default

--
Regards,
Peng

messages.author: 0c39e60ddb38622b
messages.subject: Re: How to use stat_vline with qplot?
parts:
Hi:

Is this what you were looking for?

qplot(1:10, 1:10) + geom_vline(xintercept = 5)

HTH,
Dennis
